method.start_rule: First Wednesday monthly 00:00 UTC; first Binance spot aggregate at/after nominal t0 within 60s; immutable original P0 price and actual aggregate timestamp; not live executable fill
method.event: long P>=1.05*P0 BEFORE P<=0.97*P0; no expiration, first-hit or censor
method.features: 90 strictly prestart completed daily bars; Z 7d/30d returns, 20d/60d daily realized volatility, previous-day quote volume and relative 20d quote volume; feature lookback NOT prediction horizon
method.cost_proposal: spot long/flat, 10 bps per-side fee + 5 bps per-side slippage (30 bps round-trip), must be explicitly C-frozen, test cost sensitivity 15/30/60 bps
method.censor: unresolved at administrative observed data end remains U with mark-to-market, not a loss or success

governance.asof_provenance: Binance connector normalized results only, NOT original exchange HTTP bytes, no original historical delivery timing, no executable fills; aggregates can contain multiple individual trades
governance.cross_date_overlap_warning: Source 90d prestart tapes for later events contain time intervals after earlier events; only event-local features may be passed to A/C and all training must gate label end before issue time.
governance.holdout_disclosure: All data historical as of 2026-10-27; previously explored 2026H2 calendar regimes; holdout is unscored event identities, NOT pristine independent prospective validation.
governance.immutable_previous: B150/B151 and M151 unchanged; no C/D outcome access until full freeze; no schedules or safety holds altered
